title: GATE X-E : A Challenge Set for Gender-Fair Translations from Weakly-Gendered Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation and text rewriting models on their ability to generate accurate feminine, masculine, and gender-neutral translation variants from weakly-gendered source languages. The evaluation compares model outputs against a human-annotated benchmark dataset (GATE X-E) using exact match accuracy, BLEU, WER, and human evaluation to check for spurious, missing, or extraneous gender markings (pronouns and nouns).
